say:1:1421435001:1.text: Fine! I admit it! I still serve General Thador, but I haven't done anything so far!
say:1:1421435001:1.source_cn: 好吧，我承认，我仍然在为都铎将军效力，但我目前为止什么...

choice_prompt:2:1421435001.text: Fine! I admit it! I still serve General Thador, but I haven't done anything so far!
choice_prompt:2:1421435001.source_cn: 好吧，我承认，我仍然在为都铎将军效力，但我目前为止什么都没做过！

say:3:1421435002:1.text: Simple. Thador's men are as obvious as he is.
say:3:1421435002:1.source_cn: 很简单，就像你用了点技巧就能撬开这家伙的嘴一样，都铎的...
say:3:1421435002:1.male: Simple. Thador's men are as obvious as he is.
say:3:1421435002:1.female: Simple. Thador's men are as obvious as he is.

say:4:1421435003:1.text: You can smell the military rigidity on them from across the room.
say:4:1421435003:1.source_cn: 说实话，我都不知道他们会藏在哪儿，但只要闻闻味儿就能猜...
say:4:1421435003:1.male: You can smell the military rigidity on them from across the room.
say:4:1421435003:1.female: You can smell the military rigidity on them from across the room.

say:5:1421435004:1.source_cn: 你、你知道？！那你为什么还——

say:6:1421435005:1.text: Why didn't I call it out sooner? Well, dear, as you said, you've done <style="highlight">nothing</style> so far.
say:6:1421435005:1.source_cn: 为什么不早点揭穿？就像你说过的，亲爱的，你<style...

say:7:1421435006:1.text: Leaving you all in plain sight is much easier. Why bother digging out hidden rats when they'd just be replaced with a fresh batch?
say:7:1421435006:1.source_cn: 明面上摆着至少更好观察，总比抓出来以后再派几个暗中隐藏...

say:9:1421435008:1.text: You really are just as the General said—a disgrace to the Queen's dignity! A libertine!
say:9:1421435008:1.source_cn: 你果然和将军说的一样，是个在女王尊严上抹黑的浪荡子！

choice_prompt:10:1421435008.text: You really are just as the General said—a disgrace to the Queen's dignity! A libertine!
choice_prompt:10:1421435008.source_cn: 你果然和将军说的一样，是个在女王尊严上抹黑的浪荡子！

say:11:1421435009:1.text: Well, I do hate dragging things out. Enough games—hand it over.
say:11:1421435009:1.source_cn: 行了，套话到此为止，把东西拿给我吧。

say:12:1421435010:1.text: I don't understand what you're talking about. You're here with a toplander, a traitor! I have nothing to say to you!
say:12:1421435010:1.source_cn: 我听不懂你在说什么，沙利叶“前”殿下，以及外来者，以及...

say:13:1421435011:1.text: My my, such fire! If Thador had even half your dramatic flair, perhaps he wouldn't have spent his life as just a brute.
say:13:1421435011:1.source_cn: 真热情！如果都铎有你这样的文学素养，就不至于一直只是个...

say:14:1421435012:1.text: Then again, considering I've been reduced to babysitting dragon egg essence, I'm hardly in a position to mock him.
say:14:1421435012:1.source_cn: 虽然现在沦落到给龙的蛋液看大门的我，倒是没什么资格嘲笑他……

say:15:1421435013:1.text: Let's cut to the chase, shall we? A loyal hound, enduring disgrace for his master's sake—why not just hand over what you're hiding? Unless, of course... you have nothing.
say:15:1421435013:1.source_cn: 所以，亲爱的，作为忍辱负重承载着任务的忠犬，把东西交给...

say:16:1421435014:1.text: In which case, you're no better than a stray. A poor, abandoned mutt, left behind by that disgraced dog Thador.
say:16:1421435014:1.source_cn: 那样的话，你就是都铎这个丧家之犬无情抛弃的可怜弃犬了。

say:17:1421435015:0.text:
You—!!
Your cheap taunts won't work on me!
say:17:1421435015:0.source_cn: 你！！！\n你别以为我会被你这点话术激怒！

say:18:1421435016:0.text: Oh, but dear, you're already growing like a cornered beast. Enough stalling, just tell me what you want.
say:18:1421435016:0.source_cn: 我看你已经愤怒得快要汪汪叫了。好了好了，别绕弯子，告诉...

say:19:1421435017:1.text: ...<style="highlight">The token</style>. The General described it to me. You give it to me, and I'll give you what you seek.

say:20:1421435018:1.text: Really? My face, my illustrious bloodline, none of it holds weight against some lifeless trinket? Fine.
say:20:1421435018:1.source_cn: 凭我这张脸和我众所周知的血统还比不过一件死物吗……算了。

say:21:1421435019:1.text: Not that I even remember which one he wanted. Here, take them both. They're nothing but useless keepsakes now.
say:21:1421435019:1.source_cn: 我也不知道那家伙要哪个，都给你，反正都是已经没用的破烂了。

say:22:1421435020:1.text: Ravion pulls out a brooch and a key from his coat and tosses them carelessly to Thador's subordinate.
say:22:1421435020:1.source_cn: 沙利叶从怀里摸出了那枚胸针和钥匙，将两者随意地抛给了都...
say:22:1421435020:1.male: Ravion pulls out a brooch and a key from his coat and tosses them carelessly to Thador's subordinate.
say:22:1421435020:1.female: Ravion pulls out a brooch and a key from his coat and tosses them carelessly to Thador's subordinate.

say:23:1421435021:1.text: The young man stiffly examines the brooch's shape, then carefully retrieves an old document from his own coat, returning it along with the brooch and key to Ravion.
say:23:1421435021:1.source_cn: 年轻人板着脸，认真地比对了胸针的形状，随后从怀里小心地...
say:23:1421435021:1.male: The young man stiffly examines the brooch's shape, then carefully retrieves an old document from his own coat, returning it along with the brooch and key to Ravion.
say:23:1421435021:1.female: The young man stiffly examines the brooch's shape, then carefully retrieves an old document from his own coat, returning it along with the brooch and key to Ravion.

say:24:1421435022:1.text: The document looks aged but it's folded with great care. Clearly, Thador and his subordinate had once treasured it.
say:24:1421435022:1.source_cn: 文件看起来颇为陈旧，但折叠得十分小心，显然，都铎与他忠...
say:24:1421435022:1.male: The document looks aged but it's folded with great care. Clearly, Thador and his subordinate had once treasured it.
say:24:1421435022:1.female: The document looks aged but it's folded with great care. Clearly, Thador and his subordinate had once treasured it.

say:25:1421435023:1.text: ...Now that you have it, I won't linger.
say:25:1421435023:1.source_cn: ……既然东西给了你们，我也不在这里多留了。

say:26:1421435024:0.text: The General's loyalty to Sal'thorin is beyond question. You people...
say:26:1421435024:0.source_cn: 将军对萨洛克兰的忠诚毋庸置疑，你们这些……

say:27:1421435025:0.text: Just as the young man seems ready to lash out again, he suddenly goes silent. Without another word, he turns and walks away.
say:27:1421435025:0.source_cn: 尽管年轻人看起来想再说两句狠话，但他只是突然沉默了下来...
say:27:1421435025:0.male: Just as the young man seems ready to lash out again, he suddenly goes silent. Without another word, he turns and walks away.
say:27:1421435025:0.female: Just as the young man seems ready to lash out again, he suddenly goes silent. Without another word, he turns and walks away.

say:29:1421435026:1.text: Ah, the faithful hound is no doubt returning to his master.
say:29:1421435026:1.source_cn: 忠诚的年轻人，看起来要回去找他的老头子摇尾乞怜了。

say:30:1421435027:1.text: Gotta admit, this is why I like dogs. No sense of self, just pure devotion. Always taking after their owners.
say:30:1421435027:1.source_cn: 不得不说，这就是我喜欢狗的原因：没什么自我意识，忠心耿...

say:31:1421435028:1.text: Thador was the same. He never has initiative without orders.
say:31:1421435028:1.source_cn: 没有指示就无法做出行动，给了指示就只会照本宣科——都铎...

say:33:1421435029:1.source_cn: 停止你的影射和风凉话吧。

say:34:1421435030:1.text: Fine, fine. You hold onto these for me. Let's see what we've got here.
say:34:1421435030:1.source_cn: 好好，这两样你帮我拿着，我们来看看我拿到的成果吧。

say:35:1421435031:2.text: Ravion lazily tosses the brooch and key toward Indris, ignoring his fumbling, and unfolds the document.
say:35:1421435031:2.source_cn: 沙利叶将胸针和钥匙随手抛给因度厄，不管后者如何手忙脚乱...
say:35:1421435031:2.male: Ravion lazily tosses the brooch and key toward Indris, ignoring his fumbling, and unfolds the document.
say:35:1421435031:2.female: Ravion lazily tosses the brooch and key toward Indris, ignoring his fumbling, and unfolds the document.

<style="stress">Experiment Number</style>: DR-??
<style="stress">Title</style>: ????
<style="stress">Phases</style>: Phase 1 - Postnatal observation; Phase 2 - Suppressor testing and long-term monitoring of ???

<style="highlight">Experimental Notes</style>:

<style="stress">Phase 1</style>: Newborn Observation
<style="stress">Time</style>: 24 hours after I undergo childbirth
<style="stress">Physical Characteristics</style>: The infant displayed stable vital signs at birth. Its body was fully covered in hardened scales, showing signs of severe mutation.
<style="stress">Magical Characteristics</style>: Intense magical waves that caused minor disruptions to the surroundings became apparent when approaching the subject.
<style="stress">Preliminary Diagnosis</style>: Full transference of draconization confirmed

<style="stress">Phase 2</style>: Suppressor Testing
<style="stress">Intervention</style>: The subject has been fitted with a magic suppressing device (AR-???), disguised as a gemstone brooch with concealed rune engravings.
<style="stress">Results</style>:
<style="stress">Initial Effects (0-7 Days)</style>: The scales gradually softened and fell off, while the bony spurs diminished. The subject began to take on the appearance of a normal human infant.
<style="stress">Long-Term Observation (1-3 Months)</style>: Draconization stabilized. Magical output reduced to manageable levels.
<style="stress">Conclusion</style>: AR-??? is highly effective in suppressing magic-induced draconization, though the underlying mechanism remains unclear. Further testing required to determine scope of application.

<style="stress">Long-Term Observation (??? Years)</style>:
<style="stress">Growth Progress</style>:
<style="stress">Physical Characteristics</style>: The subject shows stunted growth, with both physical and intellectual development comparable to an 8-year-old child. No significant changes have been observed in body size, bone structure, or behavior.
<style="stress">Health Condition</style>: Despite its unusually slow growth, the subject's vital signs remain stable, with no signs of weakness or disease.
<style="stress">Magical State</style>: No signs of relapse or new draconization. Energy output remains within acceptable parameters.

<style="highlight">Special Remark</style>: The AR-??? suppressor has not been removed. Its long-term containment efficiency is confirmed, but remains subject-specific. Effects of removal are untested and likely irreversible.

<style="stress">实验编号</style>：DR-▇▇▇▇
<style="stress">实验名称</style>：▇▇▇▇▇▇▇▇▇▇▇▇
<style="stress">实验阶段</style>：第一阶段-初生观测；第二阶段-抑制物适用测试；长期观测-▇▇▇▇

<style="highlight">实验记录</style>：

<style="stress">第一阶段</style>：初生观测
<style="stress">记录时间</style>：个体出生后24小时内
<style="stress">外部特征</style>：▇▇▇出生时，生命体征平稳，全身覆盖坚硬鳞片，附着过量骨质突起，呈现严重变异形态。
<style="stress">魔力特性</style>：接近个体时，明显溢出强烈的魔力扭曲波动，对周围环境造成小范围干扰。
<style="stress">初步诊断</style>：符合重度“龙化”现象。

<style="stress">第二阶段</style>：抑制物适用测试
<style="stress">实验干预</style>：个体佩戴魔力抑制器，编号AR-▇▇▇，外形为一枚暗刻符文宝石胸针。
<style="stress">观察结果</style>：
<style="stress">初期反应（0-7天）</style>：鳞片开始逐渐软化并脱落，覆盖的骨质物消退，个体外表恢复至近似正常婴儿的状态。
<style="stress">长期观察（1-3个月）</style>：魔力波动显著减弱，溢出现象消失，龙化状态未复发。
<style="stress">结论</style>：AR-▇▇▇对抑制魔力引发的龙化现象具有高效作用，机制尚不明确，是否可推广待验证。

<style="stress">长期观测</style>：（▇▇▇▇年间）
<style="stress">成长轨迹</style>：
<style="stress">身体特征</style>：个体的身体与智力发育长期停滞，等同8岁儿童水平，体型、骨骼和行为能力未见明显变化。
<style="stress">健康状况</style>：尽管成长速度异常缓慢，个体生命体征保持稳定，无任何衰弱或病变迹象。
<style="stress">魔力状态</style>：无龙化现象复发，魔力波动始终处于正常范围。
<style="highlight">特别注释</style>：AR-▇▇▇▇魔力抑制器从未移除，实验结果显示其抑制效果持续且无明显副作用，但对个体以外的龙化症状没有明显效力。移除效果尚未可知。

say:38:1421435032:0.text: The report is brief—just a record of Ravion's unnatural birth and rapid growth.
say:38:1421435032:0.source_cn: 实验报告的内容相当简洁，只是记录了沙利叶的出生和生长速...
say:38:1421435032:0.male: The report is brief—just a record of Ravion's unnatural birth and rapid growth.
say:38:1421435032:0.female: The report is brief—just a record of Ravion's unnatural birth and rapid growth.

say:39:1421435033:1.text: It also mentions his abyssal appearance at birth, though that was tempered once he donned the brooch crafted by the Queen. Nothing more after that.
say:39:1421435033:1.source_cn: 以及出生时呈现出孽化的模样，但在佩戴了女王制作的胸针后...
say:39:1421435033:1.male: It also mentions his abyssal appearance at birth, though that was tempered once he donned the brooch crafted by the Queen. Nothing more after that.
say:39:1421435033:1.female: It also mentions his abyssal appearance at birth, though that was tempered once he donned the brooch crafted by the Queen. Nothing more after that.

say:40:1421435034:1.text: To document your own child like some... experiment. This goes beyond cruelty.
say:40:1421435034:1.source_cn: 把自己的亲生儿子当成实验动物一样，令人作呕。

say:41:1421435035:1.text: Oh, I don't know. At least it states a few concrete facts. Shame it doesn't include the one thing I actually wanted most.
say:41:1421435035:1.source_cn: 我倒是觉得还不错，至少交代了一些具体的事实，只可惜没有...

choice_prompt:42:1421435035.text: Oh, I don't know. At least it states a few concrete facts. Shame it doesn't include the one thing I actually wanted most.
choice_prompt:42:1421435035.source_cn: 我倒是觉得还不错，至少交代了一些具体的事实，只可惜没有说我最想要的情报。

say:43:1421435036:1.text: Mhmm. I was half-expecting some scandalous revelation about dear General Thador. Now that would've been mortifying.
say:43:1421435036:1.source_cn: 嗯哼，说实在的，我还以为是都铎将军呢，那可真把我吓死了。
say:43:1421435036:1.male: Mhmm. I was half-expecting some scandalous revelation about dear General Thador. Now that would've been mortifying.
say:43:1421435036:1.female: Mhmm. I was half-expecting some scandalous revelation about dear General Thador. Now that would've been mortifying.

say:44:1421435038:1.text: A pity it doesn't say. But maybe that's for the best. Some things are better left in mystery.
say:44:1421435038:1.source_cn: 虽然没交代有些可惜，但没交代也不失为一件好事，就这样让...
say:44:1421435038:1.male: A pity it doesn't say. But maybe that's for the best. Some things are better left in mystery.
say:44:1421435038:1.female: A pity it doesn't say. But maybe that's for the best. Some things are better left in mystery.

choice_prompt:45:1421435038.text: A pity it doesn't say. But maybe that's for the best. Some things are better left in mystery.
choice_prompt:45:1421435038.source_cn: 虽然没交代有些可惜，但没交代也不失为一件好事，就这样让一切都隐藏在迷雾中吧。
choice_prompt:45:1421435038.male: A pity it doesn't say. But maybe that's for the best. Some things are better left in mystery.
choice_prompt:45:1421435038.female: A pity it doesn't say. But maybe that's for the best. Some things are better left in mystery.

say:46:1421435039:2.text: Anyway, since we're in the city, let's make ourselves useful. Might as well help restore order.
say:46:1421435039:2.source_cn: 好了好了，我们既然来了城里，就也别浪费时间，顺便安抚下秩序。
say:46:1421435039:2.male: Anyway, since we're in the city, let's make ourselves useful. Might as well help restore order.
say:46:1421435039:2.female: Anyway, since we're in the city, let's make ourselves useful. Might as well help restore order.

say:47:1421435040:1.text: Indris already has people stationed at the temple, so my presence there would be redundant.
say:47:1421435040:1.source_cn: 毕竟神殿那边因度厄已经安排上人手了，不需要我到场。
say:47:1421435040:1.male: Indris already has people stationed at the temple, so my presence there would be redundant.
say:47:1421435040:1.female: Indris already has people stationed at the temple, so my presence there would be redundant.

say:48:1421435041:0.text: Instead, why don't we take a little detour to the Tenebris Court? Handle some other business?
say:48:1421435041:0.source_cn: 我们回永夜圣庭那边转转——我是说干点别的活儿吧？
say:48:1421435041:0.male: Instead, why don't we take a little detour to the Tenebris Court? Handle some other business?
say:48:1421435041:0.female: Instead, why don't we take a little detour to the Tenebris Court? Handle some other business?

say:49:1421435042:1.text: I am here to ensure your safety, not to indulge your whims.
say:49:1421435042:1.source_cn: 我只是替你兜底，不是给你继续满街乱晃不老实工作的借口。

say:50:1421435043:1.text: Then stay close and make sure I stay on task. Problem solved.
say:50:1421435043:1.source_cn: 那你就好好监督，让我接下来的工作专注一点不就完事了？

say:51:1421435044:2.text: Indris snorts and strides ahead, with you trailing at a slight distance.
say:51:1421435044:2.source_cn: 因度厄哼了一声，率先向前走去，我们跟在他身后，拉开了些...
